title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: No more frozen keystrokes on big files
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.42.6 fixes the slowest thing in the extension and seven display defects around it. On a 5000 line file outside any function, a Koin module or a design system object, every keystroke walked backwards through the file once per coloured token: 13.9 seconds of frozen extension host, measured. It is one pass now.

highlights.title: One scope index per document
highlights.description: Semantic highlighting asked "is this a local?" for every token and each answer walked back through the file. Measured on a 5000 line object: 13.9 s per keystroke before, under 0.5 s for the same 5000 queries after. Inlay hints share the index.

highlights.title: Stop leaves tests unmarked
highlights.description: Stopping a run killed Gradle and turned every test red with "Gradle exited with code 1". Resource diagnostics also follow typing now instead of waiting for a save, and clear when the setting goes off.

highlights.title: Hovers that tell the truth
highlights.description: R.mipmap.ic_launcher shows its raster instead of nothing, the string hover lists locales only (no more values-night with a ✗), and items.first() on a plain list no longer wears a ⚡ borrowed from Flow.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Refreshes lenses, colours and usage counts when a file is deleted; they used to keep the deleted symbols until the next save.
Keeps Room warnings on screen while a save re-reads the workspace, reads files sixteen at a time, and underlines an unsaved entity on the right line.
